description_en: When you use Container Service for Kubernetes (ACK), you also use resources from other associated Alibaba Cloud services. Calls the DescribeClusterResources operation to query the associated resources of a specified cluster, such as VPCs and SLBs. To query node pool or node resources, call the DescribeClusterNodePools or DescribeClusterNodes operation
description_zh: 您在使用容器服务 Kubernetes 版过程中，会同时使用其他关联的阿里云云产品资源。您可以调用DescribeClusterResources接口查询指定集群的关联资源，例如VPC、SLB等。如果您需要查询节点池或节点资源，您可以调用DescribeClusterNodePools或DescribeClusterNodes接口
name: DescribeClusterResources

parameters.help_en:
The cluster ID.

For information about how to view the cluster ID, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/89446.html.

You can also call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/183905.html API operation to view information about all clusters created under your Alibaba Cloud account
parameters.help_zh:
集群ID。

关于如何查看集群ID，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/89446.html。

您也可通过API接口https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/183905.html，查看阿里云账号下所有创建的集群信息

false: Does not query the resources
parameters.help_zh:

false：不查询

state.description_en:
The resource status. Valid values:

`CREATE_COMPLETE`: The resource was created.
`CREATE_FAILED`: The resource failed to be created.
`CREATE_IN_PROGRESS`: The resource is being created.
`DELETE_FAILED`: The resource failed to be deleted.
`DELETE_IN_PROGRESS`: The resource is being deleted.
`ROLLBACK_COMPLETE`: The rollback was successful.
`ROLLBACK_FAILED`: The rollback failed.
`ROLLBACK_IN_PROGRESS`: The rollback is in progress

`DELETE_FAILED`：删除资源失败。
